_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. REQUIRES the build that adds --marked_rrip_basic_rrpv; on an older build the flag is unknown and these configs would silently be identical to their td_combined_l2_deep twins. Must be the SAME build used for td_combined_l2_deep so the two runs splice.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Three configs lifted from td_combined_l2_deep (depth_i72d48, instr_only_i96, data_only_d64) re-run with UNMARKED lines inserted at the highest possible RRPV: --marked_rrip_basic_rrpv 4. 4 is RRIP_DISTANT_VAL, the value srrip_update_evict matches on, so an unmarked line is evict-on-arrival rather than the default 3 (one aging round above the floor). marked_rrip_basic_rrpv() clamps at 4, so this is the maximum; anything higher could never satisfy the exact-equality eviction test and would age forever. The point is to widen the marked/unmarked gap from the DEMOTION side instead of by protecting marked lines harder -- the lever that still works if the depth axis has saturated. Each config keeps the name of its td_combined_l2_deep twin plus a _basic4 suffix, so both CSVs can be handed to plot_stat_change_multi.py at once and every config appears distinctly (that script merges by config name and silently keeps only the first occurrence of a duplicate).
_configurations: baseline is byte-identical to td_combined_l2_deep / td_combined_l2_resweep (L2 tree-PLRU, --mlc_cache_repl_policy 21) so all three runs share a reference; it runs no marked policy, so --marked_rrip_basic_rrpv is deliberately absent there. Each *_basic4 config is a one-flag delta from its twin in td_combined_l2_deep. CAVEAT when reading these: basic 4 is not a clean one-way knob. Because srrip_update_evict only ages when NO line sits at RRIP_DISTANT_VAL, a set holding unmarked lines at 4 yields a victim with zero aging -- so raising basic also SLOWS the aging clock, which indirectly deepens the protection of the marked lines on top of demoting the unmarked ones. Read a gain here as the combined effect, not as isolated demotion. NOTE also that with basic 4 a class-isolated config becomes close to a hard partition: instr_only_i96_basic4 pins instruction lines at -96 while every data line is evict-on-arrival, and data_only_d64_basic4 is the mirror -- these are near single-class L2s, not subtle variants.

baseline._params: REPL_PLRU_TREE (21) on the L2 -- same baseline as td_combined_l2_deep and td_combined_l2_resweep.

depth_i72d48_basic4._params: depth_i72d48 (1.5x) with unmarked lines evict-on-arrival. Both classes still gated at the nominal 0.7 / 0.5, so this is the general case: qualifying lines protected, everything else discarded first.

instr_only_i96_basic4._params: instr_only_i96 with unmarked lines evict-on-arrival. Instruction lines above the FE-bound threshold pin at -96; the data class is off (--td_load_replay_thresh 1.0) so EVERY data line now inserts evict-on-arrival. Approximates an instruction-only L2.

data_only_d64_basic4._params: data_only_d64 with unmarked lines evict-on-arrival. Mirror of the above: membound data lines pin at -64, the instruction class is off (--td_fe_rrip_thresh 1.0) so every instruction line is evict-on-arrival. Approximates a data-only L2.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Same counters as td_combined_l2_deep so the runs plot together. 'IPC' here is the TARGET-ONLY figure (Periodic_*), which is also plot_stat_change_multi.py's default; pass --full-sim there for the Cumulative_* figure.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
